rubric.text: Prepares n input qubits in |0> and one extra qubit in |1>, then applies Hadamards to all n+1 qubits.

The first oracle query acts as a phase oracle (-1)^f(x) via the |-> extra qubit, and a second Hadamard layer maps the input register to the coefficient string a while returning the extra qubit to |1>.
Recognises that after one query the offset b only appears as an unobservable global phase, so one extra query is needed.

Applies the second oracle query coherently to the same register right after the second Hadamard layer (one circuit, A = U_f H U_f H), rather than as an independent query such as f(0^n) on a fresh register.
Recovers b from the extra-qubit measurement 1 XOR b XOR p, correcting by the parity p of the measured coefficient string.
Uses exactly two oracle queries and n+1 qubits and identifies the function deterministically.
